decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 2.0 (Existing Site Block Plan), 2.0 (Proposed Site Block Plan), 3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 7.0, 9.0 and received on 7th October 2010 and numbered 6.1 and received on 29th November 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the flank elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Replacement of kitchen and outside toilet with a single storey rear extension to house.
